054/**
055 * Represents an HTTP response for a REST resource.
056 *
057 * <p>
058 *    The {@link RestResponse} object is an extension of the <l>HttpServletResponse</l> class
059 *    with various built-in convenience methods for use in building REST interfaces.
060 *    It can be accessed by passing it as a parameter on your REST Java method:
061 * </p>
062 *
063 * <p class='bjava'>
064 *    <ja>@RestPost</ja>(...)
065 *    <jk>public</jk> Object myMethod(RestResponse <jv>res</jv>) {...}
066 * </p>
067 *
068 * <p>
069 *    The primary methods on this class are:
070 * </p>
071 * <ul class='javatree'>
072 *    <li class='jc'>{@link RestResponse}
073 *    <ul class='spaced-list'>
074 *       <li>Methods for setting response headers:
075 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
076 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#addHeader(HttpHeader) addHeader(HttpHeader)}
077 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#addHeader(String,String) addHeader(String,String)}
078 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#containsHeader(String) containsHeader(String)}
079 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getHeader(String) getHeader(String)}
080 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setCharacterEncoding(String) setCharacterEncoding(String)}
081 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setContentType(String) setContentType(String)}
082 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setHeader(HttpHeader) setHeader(HttpHeader)}
083 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setHeader(HttpPartSchema,String,Object) setHeader(HttpPartSchema,String,Object)}
084 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setHeader(String,Object) setHeader(String,Object)}
085 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setHeader(String,String) setHeader(String,String)}
086 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setMaxHeaderLength(int) setMaxHeaderLength(int)}
087 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setSafeHeaders() setSafeHeaders()}
088 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setUnsafeHeaders() setUnsafeHeaders()}
089 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#downloadAs(String) downloadAs(String)}
090 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#eTag(String) eTag(String)}
091 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#eTag(EntityTag) eTag(EntityTag)}
092 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#lastModified(Instant) lastModified(Instant)}
093 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#lastModified(ZonedDateTime) lastModified(ZonedDateTime)}
094 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#cacheControl(String) cacheControl(String)}
095 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#cacheControl(CacheControl.Builder) cacheControl(CacheControl.Builder)}
096 *       </ul>
097 *       <li>Methods for setting response bodies:
098 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
099 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#flushBuffer() flushBuffer()}
100 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getDirectWriter(String) getDirectWriter(String)}
101 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getNegotiatedOutputStream() getNegotiatedOutputStream()}
102 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getNegotiatedWriter() getNegotiatedWriter()}
103 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getSerializerMatch() getSerializerMatch()}
104 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getWriter() getWriter()}
105 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#sendPlainText(String) sendPlainText(String)}
106 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#sendRedirect(String) sendRedirect(String)}
107 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#sendSafeRedirect(String,String...) sendSafeRedirect(String,String...)}
108 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setContentSchema(HttpPartSchema) setContentSchema(HttpPartSchema)}
109 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setContent(Object) setContent(Object)}
110 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setSerializer(Serializer) setSerializer(Serializer)}
111 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setResponseBeanMeta(ResponseBeanMeta) setResponseBeanMeta(ResponseBeanMeta)}
112 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setException(Throwable) setException(Throwable)}
113 *       </ul>
114 *       <li>Other:
115 *       <ul class='javatreec'>
116 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getAttributes() getAttributes()}
117 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getContext() getContext()}
118 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#getOpContext() getOpContext()}
119 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setAttribute(String,Object) setAttribute(String,Object)}
120 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setDebug() setDebug()}
121 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setNoTrace() setNoTrace()}
122 *          <li class='jm'>{@link RestResponse#setStatus(int) setStatus(int)}
123 *       </ul>
124 *    </ul>
125 * </ul>
126 *
127 */
128@SuppressWarnings({
129   "resource", // HttpServletResponseWrapper is managed by servlet container
130   "java:S115" // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase convention (e.g., HEADER_ContentType)
131})
132public class RestResponse extends HttpServletResponseWrapper {
133
134   private static final String HEADER_ContentType = "Content-Type";
135   private static final String ARG_VALUE = "value";
136   private static final Pattern ENCODING_DISABLED_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("(identity|\\*)\\s*;\\s*q\\s*=\\s*(0(?!\\.)|0\\.0)");
137
138   private HttpServletResponse inner;
139   private final RestRequest request;
140
141   private Optional<Object> content;  // The POJO being sent to the output.
142   private ServletOutputStream sos;
143   private FinishableServletOutputStream os;
144   private FinishablePrintWriter w;
145   private ResponseBeanMeta responseBeanMeta;
146   private RestOpContext opContext;
147   private Optional<HttpPartSchema> contentSchema;
148   private Serializer serializer;
149   private Optional<SerializerMatch> serializerMatch;
150   private boolean safeHeaders = true;
151   private int maxHeaderLength = 8096;
152
153   /**
154    * Constructor.
155    */
156   @SuppressWarnings({
157      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for response initialization
158      "java:S112"   // throws Exception intentional - callback/lifecycle method
159   })
160   RestResponse(RestOpContext opContext, RestSession session, RestRequest req) throws Exception {
161      super(session.getResponse());
162
163      inner = session.getResponse();
164      request = req;
165
166      this.opContext = opContext;
167      responseBeanMeta = opContext.getResponseMeta();
168
169      var context = session.getContext();
170
171      try {
172         var passThroughHeaders = request.getHeaderParam("x-response-headers").orElse(null);
173         if (nn(passThroughHeaders)) {
174            var m = context.getPartParser().getPartSession().read(HEADER, null, passThroughHeaders, MarshallingContext.DEFAULT.getClassMeta(JsonMap.class));
175            for (var e : m.entrySet())
176               addHeader(e.getKey(), resolveUris(e.getValue()));
177         }
178      } catch (Exception e1) {
179         throw new BadRequest(e1, "Invalid format for header 'x-response-headers'.  Must be in URL-encoded format.");
180      }
181
182      // Find acceptable charset
183      var h = request.getHeaderParam("accept-charset").orElse(null);
184      Charset charset = null;
185      if (h == null)
186         charset = opContext.getDefaultCharset();
187      else
188         for (var r : StringRanges.of(h).toList()) {
189            if (r.getQValue() > 0) {
190               if (r.getName().equals("*"))
191                  charset = opContext.getDefaultCharset();
192               else if (Charset.isSupported(r.getName()))
193                  charset = Charset.forName(r.getName());
194               if (nn(charset))
195                  break;
196            }
197         }
198
199      request.getContext().getDefaultResponseHeaders().forEach(x -> addHeader(x.getName(), resolveCspNonce(maybeResolveUris(x.getName(), x.getValue()))));  // Done this way to avoid list/array copy.
200
201      opContext.getDefaultResponseHeaders().forEach(x -> addHeader(x.getName(), resolveCspNonce(maybeResolveUris(x.getName(), x.getValue()))));
202
203      if (charset == null)
204         throw new NotAcceptable("No supported charsets in header 'Accept-Charset': '%s'", request.getHeaderParam("Accept-Charset").orElse(null));
205      inner.setCharacterEncoding(charset.name());
206
207   }
208
209   /**
210    * Adds a response header.
211    *
212    * <p>
213    * Any previous header values are preserved.
214    *
215    * <p>
216    * Value is added at the end of the headers.
217    *
218    * <p>
219    * If the header is a {@link HttpUriHeader}, the URI will be resolved using the {@link RestRequest#getUriResolver()} object.
220    *
221    * <p>
222    * Note that per <a class='doclink' href='https://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec4.html#sec4.2'>RFC2616</a>,
223    * only headers defined as comma-delimited lists [i.e., #(values)] should be defined as multiple message header fields.
224    *
225    * @param header The header.
226    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (ignored).
227    * @return This object.
228    */
229   public RestResponse addHeader(HttpHeader header) {
230      if (header == null) {
231         // Do nothing.
232      } else if (header instanceof HttpUriHeader header2) {
233         addHeader(header2.getName(), resolveUris(header2.getValue()));
234      } else {
235         addHeader(header.getName(), header.getValue());
236      }
237      return this;
238   }
239
240   /**
241    * Adds a response header with the given name and value.
242    *
243    * <p>
244    * This method allows response headers to have multiple values.
245    *
246    * <p>
247    * A no-op of either the name or value is <jk>null</jk>.
248    *
249    * <p>
250    * Note that per <a class='doclink' href='https://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec4.html#sec4.2'>RFC2616</a>,
251    * only headers defined as comma-delimited lists [i.e., #(values)] should be defined as multiple message header fields.
252    *
253    * @param name The header name.
254    * @param value The header value.
255    */
256   @Override
257   public void addHeader(String name, String value) {
258      if (nn(name) && nn(value)) {
259         if (eqic(name, HEADER_ContentType))
260            setHeader(name, value);
261         else {
262            if (safeHeaders)
263               value = stripInvalidHttpHeaderChars(value);
264            value = abbreviate(value, maxHeaderLength);
265            inner.addHeader(name, value);
266         }
267      }
268   }

270   /**
271    * Forces any content in the buffer to be written to the client.
272    *
273    * <p>
274    * A call to this method automatically commits the response, meaning the status code and headers will be written.
275    *
276    * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurred.
277    */
278   @Override
279   public void flushBuffer() throws IOException {
280      if (nn(w))
281         w.flush();
282      if (nn(os))
283         os.flush();
284      inner.flushBuffer();
285   }

309    * <br>If it contains an empty, then <c>setObject(<jk>null</jk>)</c> was called.
310    * <br>Otherwise, {@link #setContent(Object)} was called with a non-null value.
311    *
312    * @return The output object, or <jk>null</jk> if {@link #setContent(Object)} was never called.
313    */
314   public Optional<Object> getContent() { return content; }

316   /**
317    * Returns this value cast to the specified class.
318    *
319    * @param <T> The class to cast to.
320    * @param c The class to cast to.
321    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
322    * @return This value cast to the specified class, or <jk>null</jk> if the object doesn't exist or isn't the specified type.
323    */
324   @SuppressWarnings({
325      "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked cast
326   })
327   public <T> T getContent(Class<T> c) {
328      if (isContentOfType(c))
329         return (T)getRawOutput();
330      return null;
331   }

336    * @return The schema of the response content, never <jk>null</jk>.

338   public Optional<HttpPartSchema> getContentSchema() {
339      if (nn(contentSchema))
340         return contentSchema;
341      if (nn(responseBeanMeta))
342         contentSchema = o(responseBeanMeta.getSchema());
343      else {
344         var rbm = opContext.getResponseBeanMeta(getContent(Object.class));
345         if (nn(rbm))
346            contentSchema = o(rbm.getSchema());
347         else
348            contentSchema = oe();
349      }
350      return contentSchema;
351   }

360   /**
361    * Convenience method meant to be used when rendering directly to a browser with no buffering.
362    *
363    * <p>
364    * Sets the header <js>"x-content-type-options=nosniff"</js> so that output is rendered immediately on IE and Chrome
365    * without any buffering for content-type sniffing.
366    *
367    * <p>
368    * This can be useful if you want to render a streaming 'console' on a web page.
369    *
370    * @param contentType The value to set as the <c>Content-Type</c> on the response.
371    * @return The raw writer.
372    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
373    */
374   public PrintWriter getDirectWriter(String contentType) throws IOException {
375      setContentType(contentType);
376      setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
377      setHeader("Content-Encoding", "identity");
378      return getWriter(true, true);
379   }

395   /**
396    * Equivalent to {@link HttpServletResponse#getOutputStream()}, except wraps the output stream if an {@link Encoder}
397    * was found that matched the <c>Accept-Encoding</c> header.
398    *
399    * @return A negotiated output stream.
400    * @throws NotAcceptable If unsupported Accept-Encoding value specified.
401    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
402    */
403   @SuppressWarnings({
404      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for content negotiation
405   })
406   public FinishableServletOutputStream getNegotiatedOutputStream() throws NotAcceptable, IOException {
407      if (os == null) {
408         Encoder encoder = null;
409         var encoders = request.getOpContext().getEncoders();
410
411         var ae = request.getHeaderParam("Accept-Encoding").orElse(null);
412         if (ine(ae)) {
413            var match = encoders.getEncoderMatch(ae);
414            if (match == null) {
415               // Identity should always match unless "identity;q=0" or "*;q=0" is specified.
416               if (ENCODING_DISABLED_PATTERN.matcher(ae).find()) {
417                  throw new NotAcceptable("Unsupported encoding in request header 'Accept-Encoding': '%s'\n\tSupported codings: %s", ae, Json5.of(encoders.getSupportedEncodings()));
418               }
419            } else {
420               encoder = match.getEncoder();
421               var encoding = match.getEncoding();
422
423               // Some clients don't recognize identity as an encoding, so don't set it.
424               if (! encoding.equals("identity"))
425                  setHeader("content-encoding", encoding);
426            }
427         }
428         var sos2 = getOutputStream();
429         os = new FinishableServletOutputStream(encoder == null ? sos2 : encoder.getOutputStream(sos2));
430      }
431      return os;
432   }

568   /**
569    * Redirects to the specified URI.
570    *
571    * <p>
572    * Relative URIs are always interpreted as relative to the context root.
573    * This is similar to how WAS handles redirect requests, and is different from how Tomcat handles redirect requests.
574    *
575    * <p>
576    * This method forwards <c>uri</c> to the container as-is.  If the target is built from request input (e.g.
577    * a query parameter or header value), a caller can steer users to an arbitrary external site; use
578    * {@link #sendSafeRedirect(String,String...) sendSafeRedirect(String,String...)} instead in that case, which
579    * validates the target is either relative or points at an allow-listed host.
580    *
581    * @param uri The redirection URL.
582    * @throws IOException If an input or output exception occurs
583    */
584   @Override
585   public void sendRedirect(String uri) throws IOException {
586      var c = (!uri.isEmpty() ? uri.charAt(0) : 0);
587      if (c != '/' && uri.indexOf("://") == -1)
588         uri = request.getContextPath() + '/' + uri;
589      inner.sendRedirect(uri);
590   }
591
592   /**
593    * Redirects to the specified URI, but only if it's a relative path (interpreted per {@link #sendRedirect(String)
594    * sendRedirect(String)}) or an absolute/protocol-relative URI whose host matches one of <c>allowedHosts</c>.
595    *
596    * <p>
597    * Intended for use when the redirect target is derived from request input rather than a fixed, trusted
598    * literal, so that input can't be used to redirect a user to an arbitrary external site.
599    *
600    * @param uri The redirection URL.
601    * @param allowedHosts The hosts (case-insensitive) an absolute or protocol-relative <c>uri</c> is allowed to target.  Ignored for relative URIs.
602    * @throws IOException If an input or output exception occurs.
603    * @throws BadRequest If <c>uri</c> is absolute or protocol-relative and its host isn't in <c>allowedHosts</c>.
604    */
605   public void sendSafeRedirect(String uri, String...allowedHosts) throws IOException {
606      if (! isSafeRedirectUri(uri, allowedHosts))
607         throw new BadRequest("Redirect target '%s' is not a relative path or an allowed host.", uri);
608      sendRedirect(uri);
609   }
610
611   /**
612    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if <c>uri</c> is safe to pass to {@link #sendRedirect(String) sendRedirect(String)}
613    * without risk of redirecting to an unintended external site: either a relative path, or an absolute/
614    * protocol-relative URI whose host is in <c>allowedHosts</c>.
615    *
616    * @param uri The candidate redirection URL.
617    * @param allowedHosts The hosts (case-insensitive) an absolute or protocol-relative <c>uri</c> is allowed to target.
618    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the URI is safe to redirect to.
619    */
620   static boolean isSafeRedirectUri(String uri, String...allowedHosts) {
621      if (uri == null || uri.isEmpty())
622         return true;
623      if (uri.charAt(0) == '/' && ! uri.startsWith("//"))
624         return true;
625      if (uri.indexOf("://") == -1 && ! uri.startsWith("//"))
626         return true;
627      String host;
628      try {
629         host = new java.net.URI(uri.startsWith("//") ? "http:" + uri : uri).getHost();
630      } catch (java.net.URISyntaxException e) {
631         return false;
632      }
633      if (host == null || allowedHosts == null)
634         return false;
635      for (var h : allowedHosts)
636         if (host.equalsIgnoreCase(h))
637            return true;
638      return false;
639   }

780    * Value is added at the end of the headers.

788         // Do nothing.
789      } else if (header instanceof HttpUriHeader header2) {
790         setHeader(header2.getName(), resolveUris(header2.getValue()));
791      } else {
792         var v = header.getValue();
793         if (nn(v) && v.indexOf("://") != -1)
794            v = resolveUris(v);
795         setHeader(header.getName(), v);
796      }
797      return this;
798   }

887    *

975   /**
976    * Sets a response header with the given name and value.
977    *
978    * <p>
979    * If the header had already been set, the new value overwrites the previous one.
980    *
981    * <p>
982    * The {@link #containsHeader(String)} method can be used to test for the presence of a header before setting its value.
983    *
984    * @param name The header name.
985    * @param value The header value.
986    */
987   @Override
988   public void setHeader(String name, String value) {
989
990      // Jetty doesn't set the content type correctly if set through this method.
991      // Tomcat/WAS does.
992      if (eqic(name, HEADER_ContentType)) {
993         inner.setContentType(value);
994         ContentType ct = ContentType.of(value);
995         if (nn(ct) && nn(ct.getParameter("charset")))  // HTT: nn(ct) false arm is unreachable -- org.apache.juneau.http.header.ContentType.of(String) always returns `new ContentType(value)`, never null.
996            inner.setCharacterEncoding(ct.getParameter("charset"));
997      } else {
998         if (safeHeaders)
999            value = stripInvalidHttpHeaderChars(value);
1000         value = abbreviate(value, maxHeaderLength);
1001         inner.setHeader(name, value);
1002      }
1003   }

1094   private FinishablePrintWriter getWriter(boolean raw, boolean autoflush) throws NotAcceptable, IOException {
1095      if (nn(w))
1096         return w;
1097
1098      // If plain text requested, override it now.
1099      if (request.isPlainText())
1100         setHeader(HEADER_ContentType, "text/plain");
1101
1102      try {
1103         OutputStream out = (raw ? getOutputStream() : getNegotiatedOutputStream());
1104         w = new FinishablePrintWriter(out, getCharacterEncoding(), autoflush);
1105         return w;
1106      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
1107         var ce = getCharacterEncoding();
1108         setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");
1109         throw new NotAcceptable("Unsupported charset in request header 'Accept-Charset': '%s'", ce);
1110      }
1111   }

1114      var s = s(value);

1118   private String maybeResolveUris(String name, Object value) {
1119      return isUriBearingHeader(name) ? resolveUris(value) : s(value);

1122   /**
1123    * If a (Content-Security-Policy) header value contains a nonce placeholder, mints a single per-response nonce
1124    * (cached as a request attribute so the serializer stamps the SAME value onto inline {@code <script>}/{@code <style>}
1125    * tags) and substitutes it into the value.  Returns the value unchanged when no placeholder is present, so this is
1126    * a no-op for every non-CSP header and for CSP headers that don't use a nonce.
1127    *
1128    * @param value The already-URI-resolved header value. May be <jk>null</jk>.
1129    * @return The header value with any nonce placeholder resolved.
1130    */
1131   private String resolveCspNonce(String value) {
1132      if (value == null || ! value.contains(ContentSecurityPolicy.Builder.NONCE_PLACEHOLDER))
1133         return value;
1134      var nonce = request.getAttribute(RestRequest.CSP_NONCE_ATTR).as(String.class).orElse(null);
1135      if (nonce == null) {
1136         nonce = ContentSecurityPolicy.Builder.generateNonce();
1137         request.setAttribute(RestRequest.CSP_NONCE_ATTR, nonce);
1138      }
1139      return ContentSecurityPolicy.Builder.resolveNonce(value, nonce);
1140   }
1141
1142   private static boolean isUriBearingHeader(String name) {
1143      if (name == null)
1144         return false;
1145      return name.equalsIgnoreCase("Location")
1146         || name.equalsIgnoreCase("Content-Location")
1147         || name.equalsIgnoreCase("Referer");
1148   }
